alias_rule: Only exact canonical input identity permits reuse; preserve both fold receipts.
objective: Use the accepted five/six normalized Gaussian residual objectives, all dimensions jointly, and the frozen log-coordinate penalties. No new Jacobian or sampling variance.

optimizer.bounds_units: natural SD values; take log for optimizer. Numerical incumbent box, not a scientific prior.
optimizer.budget: Three starts per arm for each of three unique inputs; six fitted results / eighteen attempts total. No silent retries.

gates.agreement_reference: Best successful solution. Preserve and report every other attempt, including failure or differing minima.

diagnostics: Every start, all coordinates, full objective, recomputed gradient, iterations/evaluations/status/message, bound distances
At best solution, symmetrized Hessians from analytic-gradient central differences, both step sizes; eigenvalues and conditioning
Inverse observed penalized Hessian correlation for Brownian/slope labelled local log-SD curvature approximation, never empirical posterior correlation
Per cycle kernel rank, Brownian/slope Frobenius cosine, fitted covariance conditioning; geometry does not prove empirical identification
scope_limits: Calibration-only earlier-information retrospective working model; no held-out forecast gain claim from objective differences.
No new target polls, outcome scoring, F0 bank refresh, forecast simulation, public API or UI change.
2022/2024 identical calibration does not mean identical forecast features or fundamentals banks.
No posterior scale uncertainty or dependence with shared fundamentals calibration labels integrated.
implementation_tests: Exact prepared plan/source/runtime identity and rejects modified/missing inputs
Five/six objective gradients at supplied actual/synthetic points match accepted implementations
Deterministic synthetic convergence and gating tests including false success, differing starts, boundary and Hessian failures
Exclusive attempt output directory; preserve every attempt/failure and aliased provenance without overwrites
execution_contract: Root may launch after independent preparation acceptance and root review of sealed runner/tests. Execution receipt must bind this plan, preparation acceptance, runner manifest, exact interpreter/environment and original handle. Author implements/tests only; no actual historical optimization yet.
